final: WITH s1 AS (SELECT BillingState AS st, COUNT(*) AS c FROM Invoice GROUP BY BillingState), s2 AS (SELECT SUM(c) AS tot FROM s1), s3 AS (SELECT s1.st AS st, s1.c AS c, CAST(s1.c AS REAL) / NULLIF(s2.tot, 0) AS r FROM s1 JOIN s2 ON s2.tot IS NOT NULL), s4 AS (SELECT AVG(c) AS a FROM s3), s5 AS (SELECT s3.st AS st, s3.c AS c, s3.r AS r, s3.c - s4.a AS d FROM s3 JOIN s4 ON s4.a IS NOT NULL WHERE s3.c > s4.a) SELECT SUM(c), AVG(r), AVG(d) FROM s5
